pairs.subject: observability-telemetry
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/ops-telemetry.ts:13 The telemetry logger synchronously appends to an unrotated ops-warn.log file without declaring a size cap or retention reaper, allowing disk consumption to grow unbounded.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/ops-telemetry.ts:13 Log writes are append-only to ops-warn.log with no file rotation, total footprint cap, or retention reaper.
app/_lib/ops-telemetry.ts:8 opsLog restricts severity to warn/error without module targeting and writes synchronously to a separate file rather than converging through a non-blocking sink.
app/_lib/sentry-client.ts:71 Boundary errors rely solely on remote Sentry and no-op without a DSN, lacking a dedicated local crash store on disk.
app/_lib/ops-telemetry.ts:21 Subprocess runtimes write to isolated private files like pipeline.log without foreign stream capture bridging into the primary sink.
app/_lib/sentry-client.ts:80 Remote telemetry load and send failures are swallowed with no counter or recording into a local sink, violating pipeline assertion.
app/_lib/ops-telemetry.ts:32 While tailJsonl supports defensive reading for the operator API, there is no diagnostic bundle export or log directory reveal affordance.
